definitions.gloss: brave and fierce; valiant; dauntless; bold in battle
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who is both courageous and ferocious, typically in the context of fighting or facing danger. Combines the ideas of bravery and fierceness.

examples.japanese: {勇猛|ゆうもう}な⟦{武将|ぶしょう}→武将：13222_bushou⟧。
{勇猛|ゆうもう}⟦{果敢|かかん}→果敢：07934_kakan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戦|たたか}った→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧。

⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧{勇猛|ゆうもう}な⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{語|かた}り{継|つ}がれている→語り継ぐ：22312_kataritsugu⟧。
examples.english: The stories of valiant samurai who left their names in history are still passed down today.

notes:
A literary word combining {勇|ゆう} (courage) and {猛|もう} (fierce). Primarily used to describe warriors, soldiers, and heroic figures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勇猛|ゆうもう}⟦{果敢|かかん}→果敢：07934_kakan⟧: brave and bold; dauntless
- {勇猛|ゆうもう}な⟦{武将|ぶしょう}→武将：13222_bushou⟧: a valiant military commander
- {勇猛|ゆうもう}な⟦{戦士|せんし}→戦士：12747_senshi⟧: a fierce warrior
- {勇猛|ゆうもう}⟦{精進|しょうじん}→精進：13788_shoujin⟧: courageous effort (Buddhist term)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{勇敢|ゆうかん}→勇敢：07637_yuukan⟧: brave; courageous — more general and common; does not imply fierceness
- ⟦{豪胆|ごうたん}→豪胆：22155_goutan⟧: bold; daring — emphasizes fearlessness and nerve rather than fighting spirit
- ⟦{武勇|ぶゆう}→武勇：22162_buyuu⟧: martial valor — focuses on military bravery specifically

REGISTER:
Formal and literary. Most common in historical narratives, literature, and descriptions of martial characters. Rarely used in everyday conversation.
